title: Kong Agent Gateway reaches production-ready GA
summary: Agent Gateway extended Kong from LLM and MCP traffic into governed agent-to-agent communication. Together with Context Mesh and later AI Gateway 2.0, it supports a broader platform-position score.
confirmed: Kong made Agent Gateway generally available and production-ready in AI Gateway 3.14.
Kong says the product governs LLM, MCP, and A2A traffic and is available to all Kong Konnect customers as part of AI Gateway.
uncertain: The A2A market remains early, and Kong did not disclose Agent Gateway adoption, pricing, bookings, or revenue.
